title: Editor opens corrupt scene if incorrect character is present after node declaration
body: ### Tested versions - v4.7.1.stable.custom_build [a13da4feb] - v4.8.dev.custom_build [56e4e02e4] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (56e4e02e4) - 'Gentoo' '2.18' on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors (2560x1080 @ 74.94 Hz, 2000x1200 @ 59.91 Hz, 3440x1440 @ 159.86 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (nvidia; 595.84) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.54 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When you have any invalid character in a scene, normally the engine gives an error, but in some circumstances, the engine simply opens the file, with missing nodes, for example: ```toml [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://y30mf816qt5b"] [sub_resource type="GDScript" id="GDScript_08cu6"] resource_name = "script that took me hours" script/source = "extends Node func _ready() -> void: print(\"This took me hours, I hope nothing goes bad\") " [node name="Node" type="Node" unique_id=70928734] [node name="Node" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=709208734] <<<<<<< HEAD metadata/test = " ======= metadata/test1 = "" >>>>>>> branch-a " [node name="Node1" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=1613559442] script = SubResource("GDScript_08cu6") [node name="Node2" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=134649808] ``` Will have this node tree: And if you happen to accidentally save the file, the scene file will become: ```toml [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://y30mf816qt5b"] [node name="Node" type="Node" unique_id=70928734] [node name="Node" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=709208734] [node name="Node2" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=134649808] ``` The script disappears because the node that were holding a reference to it never gets loaded to begin with, so it never gets a chance to be actually in the scene in the editor. The same would happen for any other kind of resource. The actual problem is that we just need one character, basically: ```toml [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://y30mf816qt5b"] [node name="Node" type="Node" unique_id=70928734] [node name="Node" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=709208734] m [node name="Node1" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=1613559442] [node name="Node2" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=134649808] ``` the `m` will make everything under it to be ignored. If the incorrect character is located before any node gets declared, the engine correctly give an error. ### Steps to reproduce Save this scene: ```toml [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://y30mf816qt5b"] [node name="Node" type="Node" unique_id=70928734] m [node name="Node1" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=1613559442] ``` And open in the editor ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) n/a
